entries.title: LifeSciBench: Evaluating Language Models on Realistic, Expert-Level Tasks in the Life Sciences
entries.abstract: LifeSciBench contains 750 expert-authored tasks across applied life-science workflows, with heterogeneous artifacts and task-specific grading rubrics.
